assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: a seamless square material texture for the walls, ceilings, floors and corners of a richly painted dark fantasy 2D platform game. wet near-black slate, deeply entwined olive roots, sparse emerald moss, subtle jade bioluminescent veins, drowned ancient stonework. Single continuous surface filling the ENTIRE image, front-on orthographic texture, not a landscape or an object. Painterly realistic material detail with strong organic forms, muted indigo-black shadow palette; mineral accents cover less than 5 percent, no huge luminous streaks. Even scale across image, no focal point, no border, no text, no perspective, no white, no ornaments or standalone objects. Seamlessly tileable left/right and top/bottom. All four edges full material. The game masks this texture to narrow exposed surfaces with smoothly darkened interiors. Texture must feel handcrafted and match detailed side-view fantasy platforms. 1024 square.
